title: opcua: add support for loading decryption secrets from pcapng file
description:
This change enables editcap to embed an OPC UA keylog file into the pcapng file.
The opcua dissector is updated to load these secrets.
epan was updated to publish a required helper function as Dll function to be usable in a plugin.
